study: scMTR-seq human endoderm differentiation, S1 processed sublibrary
biological_replicate: Unresolved in selected released metadata; S1 is a technical sublibrary, not a biological replicate label
pairing_evidence: GEO explicitly identifies the paired RNA and DNA samples; pinned author figure3 scripts define first three split-pool barcode parts plus S1 as canonical identity and resolve RNA RT tags before joining
RT_resolution: Choose highest matrix count RT-tag row per canonical cell; require dominant fraction >0.5 and tag01..04 for RNA QC. Matrix-count fraction is a documented proxy for author read-summary fraction, not exact replication of unpublished read-summary QC.
unresolved_collision: Same-day doublets and split-pool barcode collisions cannot be excluded solely from released counts
feature_reference_format: GEO .csv.gz filenames actually contain gzipped XLSX workbooks; extracted selected endoderm rows without inferring antibody IDs from filenames
inherited_source_QC: Authors prepare.DNA.fragments.R filters cells on >=2500 total DNA observations across six targets before exporting mark-specific fragments; cannot remove that inherited use of unavailable targets
reference_annotation: Existing local GENCODEv49 (Ensembl115), not a new biological measurement
source_identity_checks: Downloaded lengths+SHA256 and full gzip reads; no independent GEO publisher checksum advertised
transport_limitation: Transient empty HTTP bodies on tiny feature-reference downloads were rejected; failed partials and original failure report retained; successful bounded retries validated Content-Length.
